calculation_handling.description: Measurement rule: the required minimum ancillary building setbacks apply to all above-ground and below-ground parts of a laneway-suite building, excluding footings.
calculation_handling.gaps: A rule on which parts of the building the setbacks are measured to; it defines no single DSL variable, so target is 'none'. No zone is named.

units.disclosure: Laneway suite setbacks are measured to every part of the building above and below ground (except footings). We do not model below-grade parts.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2) and (5) and 10.10.60.20(1), the minimum rear yard setback of a laneway-suite building is 0.0 m if the rear lot line does not abut a street or lane and the rear main wall has no openings (vehicle access, doors or windows).
calculation_handling.gaps: The conditions are negations (rear lot line does NOT abut a street or lane; NO openings in the rear wall); the condition grammar has no negated token, so condition is 'none' and the arm depends on the lot's rear abutment and on the user's wall openings (suite_wall_openings). Displaces 10.5.60.20(2), 10.5.60.20(5) and 10.10.60.20(1) for laneway suites. No zone is named.

units.disclosure: Laneway suite setbacks apply only if you plan a laneway suite; we apply them when you tell us one is planned.

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases (rear lot line abuts a street or lane, or the rear wall has openings), the minimum rear yard setback of a laneway-suite building is 1.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'in all other cases' is the complement of (2)(A), which has no expressible condition; condition is 'none'. Displaces 10.5.60.20(2), 10.5.60.20(5) and 10.10.60.20(1) for laneway suites. No zone is named.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3) and (6) and 10.10.60.20(1), the minimum side yard setback of a laneway-suite building is 0.0 m if the side lot line does not abut a street or lane and the side main wall has no openings.
calculation_handling.gaps: The conditions are negations with no negated token in the grammar; condition is 'none'. Depends on side-lot-line abutment and the user's wall openings. Displaces 10.5.60.20(3), 10.5.60.20(6) and 10.10.60.20(1) for laneway suites. No zone is named.

calculation_handling.description: If the side lot line abuts a street, the minimum side yard setback of the laneway-suite building is the required minimum side yard setback for the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Incorporates the residential building's required side yard setback by reference; no literal of its own, so keyed as INCLUDE (the template has no include_ref field; the referenced value is the zone's side setback for the residential building on a street side). The street-abutting side lot line has no plain lot_condition token, so condition is 'none'. No zone is named.

evidence.abuts_lane: rear lot line abuts a lane

calculation_handling.description: If the side lot line abuts a lot in the R, RD, RS, RT or RM zone and the rear lot line abuts a lane, the part of the laneway-suite building above a height of 4.0 m must be set back 1.5 m from a side lot line that abuts the rear lot line of another lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: A stepback above 4.0 m, not a whole-building setback; the 4.0 m height threshold is listed as not expressed. The neighbouring lot's residential zone and the side-lot-line-abuts-rear-lot-line geometry have no tokens; the R/RD/RS/RT/RM zones describe the abutting lot, not where the unit applies, so application.zones is empty.

150.8.60.20(1).explanation: Laneway suite setbacks apply to every part of the building, above and below ground, except the footings.

150.8.60.20(2).explanation: A laneway suite can be built right at the rear lot line (0.0 m) if that line does not border a street or lane and the rear wall has no doors, windows or vehicle openings; otherwise it must be at least 1.0 m back.

150.8.60.20(3).explanation: A laneway suite can be built at the side lot line (0.0 m) if that line does not border a street or lane and the side wall has no openings. On a street side it must match the house's side setback. Beside another residential lot's rear yard on a lane lot, the part above 4.0 m must step back 1.5 m. Otherwise the side setback is at least 1.0 m.
